suppress_nevergrad_warnings: use the suppress_nevergrad_warnings context manager to ignore NevergradWarning during test execution
assert_set_equal: assert two iterables contain the same elements using assert_set_equal with a custom error message
printed_assert_equal: compare two values with printed_assert_equal to get debug output on assertion failure
assert_markdown_links_not_broken: check all relative markdown links in a folder are valid using assert_markdown_links_not_broken
parametrized: decorate a pytest test function with parametrized to run named parameterized test cases
